slug: 2024-06-27 WURI digital ID project improving access to public services in Benin

facts.fact: Biometric Update, citing the World Bank blog, says the fID is carried on a mobile application linked to a variety of services in Benin and authenticates identity by QR code.
Biometric Update says about 99 percent of Beninese hold a legal and digital identity with which they can access services in education, finance and government social assistance programmes.
